classification: For a given endpoint/rule, any matching source record in the recovered query table exposes its whole project-normalized compound; evaluate only rows with frozen saved R5 ensemble predictions. Never divide duplicate compounds between matched/nonmatched. Stereo-stripped matches can cover multiple normalized compound IDs.
estimand: Mean across normalized compounds of within-compound mean paired absolute-error differences, candidate minus reference. Do not average labels before absolute errors.

bootstrap.interval: unadjusted conditional percentile 95%; numpy linear quantiles
bootstrap.rng: fresh default_rng(seed) per cohort/rule/stratum/unit, common draws for contrasts, sorted IDs, verified R6 ratio kernel

external_components: For uniform-dominant and prior-uniform only, T60 and T70 existing labels. Resample retained nonempty components and use sampled delta total / sampled compound count. At least two distinct components required; fewer gives explicit NA CI, never zero-width invented intervals. Subsetting does not rebuild components.
small_strata: Empty: NA point/CI; singleton compound: finite point, NA bootstrap CI. Component <2: finite point if available, NA CI. Always record status and counts.
preservation: No new fitting, forward prediction, source/model/target changes, residual removal, or replacement of primary results. All 12 cohort/rule/stratum cells reported regardless of matching rate or effect.
interpretation: Recovered candidate-public-training-corpus overlap is not proof of exact deployed-checkpoint membership. Nonmatched is not certified unseen; normalization failures, partial attribution and version gaps remain. Released validation, Novartis and SAMPL matches do not enter the training-candidate union.
